verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's layout and spacing almost exactly, just centred vertically in the slightly taller canvas. The headline still breaks as 'Cucumber Mint / is back', and the text column's spacing stays even. That is close to a straight copy rather than a rethink, but the change in shape is small, so it is still good work. B breaks the headline more awkwardly ('Cucumber / Mint is back', which splits the product name) and stretches the gaps unevenly: there is a large space between the headline and the body copy, and a bigger one above the CTA. This loosens how the text column holds together. The enlarged circle also crowds the bottom edge.
